# EasyCards

> EasyCards is real-time digital job card and workshop management software for New Zealand automotive workshops, mechanics, panelbeaters, and WOF inspectors. It replaces paper job cards with an admin web portal and a mobile app, and invoices directly through Xero or Easy Cards itself.

## Product

- Admin web portal to create job cards, assign technicians, and track job status in real time.
- Native iOS and Android app for technicians: job details, time and labour logging, parts tracking, photos, push notifications.
- Digital WOF inspection module (NZTA-compliant) for warrant of fitness checks and certificates.
- Batch invoicing straight from Easy Cards or via one-click sync to Xero — no re-keying.

## Pricing

- Admin portal: $25/month intro (normally $49/month), one admin seat included.
- Per technician: $10/month intro (normally $15/month), unlimited technicians.
- WOF module add-on: $5/tech/month intro (normally $12.50), optional.
- 28-day free trial, no credit card required, cancel anytime.
